intro: One medium karipap is about 130 kcal (estimate). The calories come from the pastry and the oil it absorbs during frying.
diet: Yes, karipap is not the enemy. The problem is it's hard to stop at one. Two or three with teh tarik is already like a plate of rice. If you want one, take one piece and pair it with a plain drink.
tips: Buy just one piece, not a whole bag for yourself.
Dab off extra oil with a tissue before eating.
Pair it with a boiled egg or a glass of milk so you feel fuller.

swap.name: Pau kacang merah or pau ayam
swap.why: Steamed, not fried, so lower in fat and more filling.

faq.q: What's the difference between karipap pusing and normal karipap?
faq.a: Karipap pusing has layered pastry that uses more fat, so it's usually crispier and higher in calories.

faq.q: Can I cook karipap in an air fryer?
faq.a: Yes. Brush with a thin layer of oil and air fry at 180°C for about 12 to 15 minutes. It comes out less oily.

faq.q: How long can frozen karipap keep?
faq.a: Usually a few months in the freezer. Fry or bake straight from frozen, no need to thaw.
